name: bash-corpus-production
complexityPolicy: one production parseFile pass per acceptance file; the bash analyzer uses one iterative DFS over the tree with constant-time scope stack, Map-based function params, declaration-dedupe set, and Set-backed relationship dedupe — O(nodes + emitted facts), no per-symbol relationship scan
corpusPolicy: tracked .sh/.bash files from clean fsharp@22a8a5dc; two named grammar-level limitations (POSIX-class regex match and ] pattern expansion) are excluded and measured separately by bash-corpus-errors.ts
